name: Earth Pro
subtitle: Desktop Globe & KML Maps
promotionalText: Google Earth Pro desktop downloads end June 25, 2027. Keep a desktop workflow with an independent Mac app for KML projects, custom pins, measurements, and overlays.
description:
A desktop home for your map projects.

Google Earth Pro is moving away from new desktop downloads. Google has announced that downloads end June 25, 2027; existing installations can continue working. Earth Pro gives Mac users an independent, native desktop alternative for exploring a globe and working with their own places.

KEEP YOUR DESKTOP MAPPING WORKFLOW
Bring supported placemarks, paths, and polygons from KML or KMZ files into a Mac workspace. Organize your places, measure distance and land, add image overlays, and export saved places as KML. Start with the globe, Apple Maps, or OpenStreetMap without a Google API key.

MAP YOUR PLACES
Paste up to 250 addresses, choose a pin color, and plot the matches together. Duplicate lines are skipped, unresolved addresses are listed for correction, and the map frames your results. Search suggestions help you find individual addresses; selecting a result zooms to its highlighted pin.

MAKE THE MAP YOURS
Give placemarks their own colors, shapes, icons, and notes. Draw paths and polygons, organize saved places, and import KML or KMZ projects. Export your places as KML to use elsewhere.

MEASURE WITH THE DETAIL YOU NEED
Measure distances, perimeters, and polygon areas with selectable units and decimal precision. Follow coordinates, approximate elevation, and camera altitude while you explore.

BRING IN MORE CONTEXT
Search geographic layers, compare dated NASA imagery, and position your own image overlays with adjustable bounds, rotation, and opacity. Record silent map videos or save a view as an image.

START WITH FREE MAP PROVIDERS
Explore the globe, Apple Maps, or OpenStreetMap without a Google API key. You can add your own compatible Google Maps API key for Google imagery and photorealistic 3D buildings and terrain where supported. Google may charge separately for API usage.

OPTIONAL LOCAL AI CONTROL
Enable the local Model Context Protocol (MCP) server when you want a compatible LLM client to navigate, work with pins and geometry, plot address lists, manage overlays, or record video. MCP is off by default and uses a session token on your Mac.

Earth Pro needs no app account. Saved places and projects stay on your Mac; online searches, maps, and data use the selected providers. Source code is available under the MIT license, with separate terms for third-party map services and datasets.

Requires macOS 14 or later. Online maps and data require an internet connection. Address matches, 3D coverage, imagery dates, and elevation accuracy vary by provider and location. Historical NASA imagery is a daily satellite archive, not a street-level aerial history. Earth Pro is independently developed and is not affiliated with Google.
reviewNotes:
No Earth Pro account or Google API key is required. Test the globe, Apple Maps, and OpenStreetMap immediately. Optional Google maps and photorealistic 3D require the user's own compatible Google Maps API key in map provider settings; the key is stored in macOS Keychain. Google may charge separately. NASA historical imagery is a daily satellite archive, not Google's historical aerial archive.

Test address-list plotting from Add > Plot Address List: paste one complete address per line. Duplicates are skipped, unresolved entries are reported, and partial matches are kept. Edit pin colors, shapes, and icons in My Places. Measurements support selectable distance/area units and precision. Image Overlays and Local MCP are toolbar controls. MCP is disabled by default, loopback-only, and session-token protected. Video records the map without audio. Help links to support and privacy. Original app code is MIT-licensed; provider data and imagery retain their own terms.

The app accesses public Wikimedia geographic articles/photos as optional reference layers, with attribution and source links. It has no social feed, in-app public posting, user accounts, or messaging.

Marketing context checked October 16, 2026: Google announced the end of new Google Earth Pro desktop downloads on June 25, 2027, while existing installations can continue working. Source: https://support.google.com/earth/thread/448773864 . Earth Pro is independently developed, not affiliated with Google, and does not claim to duplicate every Google Earth feature. The wording refers to the desktop download change, not a shutdown of installed copies.
